card.name: Dosing phrases in fluoxetine instructions
card.fires_on: Words like "the", "morning", "treatment" or "maintenance" inside dosing instructions, mostly for fluoxetine, just before a time of day, a dose size, or a phase of treatment.

modes.label: Time of day
modes.description: The word "morning" in "20 mg/day in the morning" for fluoxetine dosing.
modes.example: Initiate fluoxetine tablets 20 mg/day orally in the<< morning>>.

modes.label: Linking word before a phase or dose
modes.description: "the" before a treatment phase or starting capsule strength.
modes.example: Evidence of therapeutic benefit should be evaluated at the end of<< the>> induction phase to determine need for continued treatment

modes.label: Treatment or maintenance noun
modes.description: A treatment-related noun before "session" or "dose" in schedule guidance.
modes.example: For patients who miss<< treatment>> session(s) during maintenance treatment and have
